stories.title: Casi 13.000 viajeros afectados tras interrumpirse la circulación entre Barcelona y Madrid por el incendio de un tren en Zaragoza

en.title: Almost 13,000 travelers affected after rail service between Barcelona and Madrid interrupted due to train fire in Zaragoza
en.summary: High-speed rail service between Madrid and Barcelona was halted after a fire broke out in an AVE train near Ricla, Zaragoza. The incident affected nearly 13,000 passengers and 33 trains, with 283 people evacuated from the burning train.

stories.title: Restablecida parcialmente la circulación de Alta Velocidad entre Barcelona y Madrid tras el incendio en la máquina de cola de un tren en Ricla (Zaragoza) y Renfe cifra en 5.000 los pasajeros afectados

en.title: High-speed service between Barcelona and Madrid partially restored after train fire in Ricla, Zaragoza; Renfe reports 5,000 affected passengers
en.summary: High-speed rail service between Barcelona and Madrid has been partially restored following a fire in a train's rear cabin near Ricla. The fire has been extinguished, with approximately 5,000 passengers affected, though the total could exceed 10,000 when including other operators.

stories.title: El Supremo confirma la suspensión del censo de la 'ley de nietos': no podrán votar

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court confirms suspension of 'grandchildren law' electoral registry; affected voters cannot participate in November 29 elections
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court has upheld the suspension of the electoral registry for the 'grandchildren law,' preventing affected voters from participating in upcoming elections. The court found that the administration failed to properly separate valid applications from invalid ones, maintaining risk of electoral fraud.

stories.title: Un incendio en un AVE interrumpe la línea Madrid-Barcelona y altera los planes de viaje de 19.500 viajeros

en.title: Fire on AVE train interrupts Madrid-Barcelona line and disrupts travel plans for 19,500 passengers
en.summary: A fire on a high-speed train disrupted the Madrid-Barcelona route, affecting 19,500 travelers. Rail service was restored on a single track before 21:00 hours after five hours of interruption, with rail operators using buses to transport affected passengers to their destinations.

stories.title: Sánchez admite que buques marroquíes entraron en aguas de Ceuta durante la invasión

en.title: Sánchez admits that Moroccan vessels entered Ceuta waters during the migration influx
en.summary: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez acknowledged that Moroccan ships entered Ceuta's territorial waters during a large-scale arrival of over 80,000 migrants on July 30-31, though he characterized it as an isolated incident and stated that normalcy is returning to the autonomous city.

stories.title: El PSOE denuncia tras la decisión del Supremo que los nietos del "franquismo" sí podrán votar pero los de los "exiliados", no

en.title: PSOE denounces Supreme Court decision allowing descendants of Francoist officials to vote while denying descendants of exiles the same right
en.summary: The Socialist Party criticized a Supreme Court ruling regarding voting rights for descendants of those affected by a historical law, accusing opponents of seeking to prevent voting rather than supporting democratic participation.

stories.title: El Supremo mantiene la suspensión del voto para la 'ley de nietos': "El riesgo de que se constituya irregularmente un censo de electores persiste con la misma intensidad"

en.title: Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting for 'grandchildren's law': 'Risk of irregularly constituting an electoral census persists with the same intensity'
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court rejected the government's appeal to lift a suspension on a voting measure, ruling 5-1 that risks of improper electoral registry formation remain unchanged.

stories.title: El incendio de un AVE corta durante cinco horas la línea de alta velocidad entre Barcelona y Madrid

en.title: AVE train fire disrupts high-speed rail line between Barcelona and Madrid for five hours
en.summary: A fire in the rear cabin of a train carrying 283 passengers caused no injuries but disrupted service for over 11,000 travelers on approximately 40 other trains along the Barcelona-Madrid route.

stories.title: Malestar en el Gobierno tras la decisión del Supremo sobre la ‘ley de nietos’: “Parece que el derecho a voto no es tan relevante para algunos”

en.title: Government discontent following Supreme Court decision on 'grandchildren's law': "It seems that the right to vote is not so relevant for some"
en.summary: The Interior Minister criticized the Supreme Court's decision while the opposition party praised it as a check on alleged government attempts to influence the electoral registry.

stories.title: Sánchez confirma que buques de guerra marroquíes entraron en aguas de Ceuta a finales de julio

en.title: Sánchez confirms that Moroccan warships entered Ceuta waters in late July
en.summary: Spain's government president acknowledged that Moroccan naval vessels were present near the autonomous city of Ceuta in late July, coinciding with a large influx of migrants.

stories.title: El TS mantiene la suspensión del voto para los nacionalizados con la 'ley de nietos'

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the 'grandchildren law'
en.summary: The court upheld the suspension preventing new registrations for the election, though it permitted voting rights for those already registered under the Democratic Memory law before August 1.

stories.title: El Supremo mantiene para el 29-N la suspensión del derecho al voto de los nacionalizados por la ‘ley de nietos’

en.title: Supreme Court maintains suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the 'grandchildren law' for November 29
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court rejected an appeal by the state legal office and upheld the suspension of voting rights for approximately 163,000 naturalized citizens, giving them five days to submit arguments.

stories.title: Zuckerberg rechaza frenar la IA: "Meta ha alcanzado a sus rivales"

en.title: Zuckerberg rejects slowing AI: "Meta has caught up with its rivals"
en.summary: Meta's leader highlights the launch of the new Muse Wonder model following substantial investments to compete with rivals in the artificial intelligence race.

stories.title: Frente Amplio designa a Ada Colau como candidata en las elecciones

en.title: Frente Amplio designates Ada Colau as candidate in elections
en.summary: The coalition leaves the door open for Podemos to join Frente Amplio, following an agreement between Podemos and ERC for collaboration in Catalonia.

stories.title: Las auditoras Audria y Activa se fusionan y crean Nexia Audiva

en.title: Audit firms Audria and Activa merge to create Nexia Audiva
en.summary: Two Barcelona-based professional services firms combine to form a new entity with 70 professionals and annual revenue of 6.5 million euros.

stories.title: Starbucks descarta la compra de Chipotle Mexican Grill

en.title: Starbucks rules out purchasing Chipotle Mexican Grill
en.summary: Starbucks states its leadership remains focused on its 'Back to Starbucks' strategy and maintains strong momentum and confidence in long-term growth prospects.

stories.title: El Ibex firma su mayor subida desde julio animado por los bancos

en.title: Ibex posts largest gain since July driven by banks
en.summary: Spain's Ibex index achieved its biggest advance since July, leading European gains as the earnings season begins. Banks led the rally amid investor focus on how debt market movements affect their operations.
